independenceStatement: This reviewer did not author or modify the reviewed production UI, validation harness, or immutable browser collection. The reviewer wrote only the assigned reviewer-report.json and reviewer-report.md and did not touch production UI, tests, collection inputs, frozen design artifacts, specifications, task checkboxes, owner artifacts, Git staging, or commits.

buildIdentity.displayScaleBasis: The 1280x760 PNG equals the recorded 1280x760 CSS viewport; this is the browser capture scale and is not a claim about a physical macOS display.

reviewedCollections.role: semantic browser authority and fixed browser screenshot

visualChecks.check: Hidden Sidebar releases its shell space
visualChecks.expected: No visible Sidebar remains, and the Tabs and canvas reclaim the released horizontal space.
visualChecks.actual: The Sidebar is absent; the compact controls and first Tab begin at the far-left shell region while the canvas spans the window below.

visualChecks.expected: Compact Sidebar and Back icon controls remain at the far-left of the top shell layer.
visualChecks.actual: Both compact icon controls are visible at the far-left without a textual Sidebar or large Pin/Unpin control.

visualChecks.check: Restored Tabs preserve the approved visible state cues
visualChecks.expected: The frozen HF2-02 baseline visibly marks Migration.excalidraw as unsaved with a small circular marker; the component contract requires a visible non-colour cue for unsaved state.
visualChecks.actual: The fixed actual capture shows no circular unsaved marker in the Migration.excalidraw Tab or any other Tab.

visualChecks.expected: The app-owned recovery status is present below the top shell with restrained emphasis and an accurate three-drawing count.
visualChecks.actual: Recovered · 3 drawings restored appears at the approved left/top position with the expected quiet panel treatment and clear text hierarchy.

visualChecks.check: Light shell palette and tab/canvas composition
visualChecks.expected: Light semantic surfaces remain restrained, the top shell is distinct from the canvas, and app-owned chrome does not compete with the SDK editor.
visualChecks.actual: The Light shell surfaces, dividers, Tabs, and recovery notice preserve the approved restrained hierarchy outside the SDK-owned interior.

masks.justification: Approved official Excalidraw SDK-owned editor interior. The selector does not include the Tabs, top shell, canvas boundary, or the sibling app-owned recovery notice; those regions were reviewed.

maskRationale: Only the official Excalidraw editor interior is excluded. Its boundary remains visible, and the mask does not excuse or conceal the app-owned Tabs, compact controls, recovery notice, or shell perimeter.

tolerances.browserGeometryTolerance: ±2 CSS px; owned by the bound collector and not re-proved from the screenshot

rasterOnlyTolerance.scope: collector-owned auxiliary shell-tabs repeated-capture stability check only

findings.screenState: 02 · Restored · Hidden · Light / Migration.excalidraw unsaved Tab state
findings.expected: The frozen baseline shows a visible circular unsaved marker in Migration.excalidraw, consistent with the HF-2 Tab contract requiring a visible non-colour unsaved cue.
findings.actual: The fixed actual capture omits the circular unsaved marker from Migration.excalidraw and from the other visible Tabs. The active underline or other colour treatment cannot replace the required visible marker.
findings.reproduction: Open the manifest-verified restored-hidden-light.png and the immutable actual.png separately at 100%. Compare the Migration.excalidraw Tab in the top strip: the baseline includes a purple circular marker between the title and close slot; actual.png does not.

unverified: A native macOS package, bundle identifier, native window, physical display scale, native menus, and system dialogs were not reviewed; they are intentionally outside this intermediate browser-only checkpoint.
The recorded capture scale is derived from matching PNG and CSS viewport dimensions and does not establish the physical macOS display scale.

Exact geometry, tokens, fonts, accessibility, keyboard operation, focus-visible, reduced motion, persistence, filesystem outcomes, and recovery behavior were not re-proved from pixels; the immutable semantic collector and focused deterministic checks own those facts.

The browser collection does not record an explicit semantic assertion for the visible unsaved marker state; this review fails the visible baseline mismatch rather than inferring semantic state from pixels.

The separate T046 deterministic process/filesystem collection at docs/evidence/003-visual-acceptance/030f279b21bb603d1545e2920aac5a25ae20d977/HF2-02/collection/recovery-process owns recovery safety. This visual review does not prove recovery safety.
HF2-01, VSL-001, HF2-04, HF2-05, and HF2-06 were not reviewed by this single-screen checkpoint.
No product-owner decision was created or inferred because ownerRequirement is NOT_REQUIRED for HF2-02.
